name: XRHealth
short_description: FDA-registered VR/XR therapeutic platform with Medicare-reimbursed telehealth services for mental health, pain management, and rehabilitation delivered by licensed clinicians.
long_description: XRHealth is the leading XR therapeutic platform and the only FDA-registered, multidisciplinary XR solution with CMS-classified VR CBT device covered as Durable Medical Equipment (DME). The platform addresses mental health conditions including PTSD, trauma, anxiety, phobias, OCD, ADHD, stress, and addictive disorders through VR-delivered therapy. XRHealth operates a virtual clinic staffed by licensed Physical Therapists, Occupational Therapists, and Licensed Clinical Social Workers specially trained in VR therapy. The platform features over 150 therapeutic applications, direct EHR integration with Epic and Cerner, AI-powered personalized therapy programs, and real-world data collection from patients at home. With 1M+ sessions delivered and partnerships with VA and NHS, XRHealth offers both full-service VR (software + in-clinic headsets) and software-only remote treatment options.
one_liner: FDA-registered VR therapeutic platform with Medicare-reimbursed telehealth
best_for: and mental health practices seeking FDA-registered

pricing.notes: Per clinician license with flexible packages. Full-service VR includes software + headsets. Software-only for remote treatment. Medicare DME reimbursement available.
